name: paste
title: chunk:paste
lead: Clipped to this chunk; air is skipped unless `air` is true. `part` names the paste for `citadel render --part` and `citadel check`; the build's own `b:part`s are then inside it ("house/roof").
signature: chunk:paste(schem: Schematic, origin: Vec3, opts: { air: boolean ?, part: string ? }?)

usedIn.quote: chunk:paste(cottage, vec3(0, 64, 0) + cottage.min) -- only the part in this chunk
`chunk:paste` puts the part of the cottage that falls in each chunk as
--   chunk:paste(schem, origin)    a schematic, clipped to the chunk
- `chunk:paste` and `world.paste` take a build like any schematic. Make it
